name: foldaway
title: Fold-away
description: A sheet of paper unfolds across the screen, the route swaps behind it, then it folds itself back into a strip and drops off the edge. GSAP.
docs:
Wrap your layout with the transition. This is the only step:

  // app/layout.tsx
  import { FoldAwayTransition } from "@/components/foldaway"

  export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
    return (
      <html lang="en">
        <body>
          <FoldAwayTransition panels={4}>{children}</FoldAwayTransition>
        </body>
      </html>
    )
  }

Your existing <Link>s are intercepted automatically.

panels sets how many sections the sheet folds into — more panels means more
creases and a shorter strip when it collapses. direction takes bottom, top,
left or right: the edge the sheet folds down to and leaves through.

Colour: four paper stocks ship as presets — paper="kraft" (default),
"newsprint", "blueprint" or "ink". For anything else pass paper="custom" and
set --fold-paper, --fold-paper-back and --fold-crease yourself in
components/transitions.css.

Note: browser back/forward is not animated, and the route does not start
loading until the leave phase finishes (~1.1s).
